source: coordinator brief: make pending_claude_triggers.task_id nullable for taskless (scheduler/webhook/research) triggers
summary: pending_claude_triggers.task_id is declared TEXT NOT NULL in both SQLite (migrations.ts) and Postgres (postgres_bootstrap.ts), but scheduler/webhook/research triggers insert task_id=NULL. Every taskless insert fails at runtime with a NOT NULL constraint violation. Make task_id nullable in both engines while preserving UNIQUE(task_id) and ON DELETE CASCADE.

criteria.text: A fresh migrated SQLite DB: inserting a trigger with task_id=NULL (plus scheduled_task_id/prompt) SUCCEEDS.
criteria.test_id: AC1: fresh migrated DB accepts a NULL task_id trigger insert

criteria.text: An EXISTING SQLite DB created with the old NOT NULL schema + seeded rows: after migration task_id is nullable, all pre-existing rows preserved, and a NULL insert succeeds.
criteria.test_id: AC2: existing NOT NULL DB is rebuilt, rows preserved, NULL insert then succeeds

criteria.text: UNIQUE(task_id) still enforced for NON-null task_ids (duplicate non-null insert rejected) AND multiple NULL task_ids allowed.
criteria.test_id: AC3: UNIQUE(task_id) rejects duplicate non-null but permits multiple NULLs

criteria.text: ON DELETE CASCADE still works (deleting a task removes its trigger).
criteria.test_id: AC4: deleting a task cascades to remove its pending trigger

criteria.text: Postgres bootstrap statements are present and idempotent (nullable CREATE + ALTER ... DROP NOT NULL).
criteria.test_id: AC5: postgres_bootstrap declares task_id nullable and DROP NOT NULL statement present

criteria.text: The scheduler/webhook/research insert paths now succeed against the migrated schema (direct NULL insert mirroring agentSchedulerService's INSERT columns).
criteria.test_id: AC6: scheduler-shaped taskless INSERT (full scheduler column set) succeeds

criteria.text: tsc build stays clean and the full api_server vitest suite stays green (0 regressions).
